description: 将拓扑 DSL 升级为严格端口级关系模型：输入/输出都必须显式映射到 Device.Port，移除 driven_by/reports_to/detects 的旧写法兼容，并以双输入阀为首个标准场景。

userStories.title: 新增端口级 relation DSL 语法
userStories.description: As a DSL author, I want relation blocks with explicit from/to ports so that every physical connection is unambiguous.
acceptanceCriteria: `[topology]` 支持声明 relation，包含 `from: Device.Port`、`to: Device.Port`、`via: driven_by|reports_to|detects`
Parser 将 relation 映射到 `TopologySection.connections`，并写入 `from_port`/`to_port`
relation 缺少 from/to/via 任一字段时给出可定位的语法或语义错误
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: 移除旧拓扑属性写法（破坏性变更）
userStories.description: As a platform maintainer, I want to remove legacy topology attributes so that the codebase has one strict standard.
acceptanceCriteria: DSL 不再接受设备属性 `driven_by`、`reports_to`、`detects`
Parser/semantic 中删除由设备属性自动推导连接的逻辑
使用旧写法时返回明确迁移错误，提示改用 relation + Device.Port
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: 语义门禁改为严格端口校验
userStories.description: As a safety engineer, I want semantic gate validation to run on explicit ports only so that ambiguous topology is rejected early.
acceptanceCriteria: 对每条 relation 执行端口存在性校验（SEM-101）
对每条 relation 执行方向校验 output -> input（SEM-102）
对每条 relation 执行类型兼容性校验（SEM-103）
可选语义角色校验保持可用（SEM-104）
悬空端口校验仅基于显式 relation 参与情况（SEM-105）
不再进行任何隐式端口推断（即使设备只有一个端口）
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: 拓扑图与因果验证切换到端口关系源
userStories.description: As a verification engineer, I want graph building and causality checks to use explicit port relations so that diagnostics match physical wiring.
acceptanceCriteria: Topology graph 仅消费 `TopologySection.connections`
因果链验证仍支持设备级 chain 表达，但其可达性必须来自端口级 relation 图
错误信息包含关键端口上下文（例如 `valve_eject.coil_retract`）
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: 实现双输入阀标准建模（可扩展到多 IO 设备）
userStories.description: As a controls engineer, I want a dual-coil valve model with explicit port mapping so that each PLC output maps to a concrete physical coil.
acceptanceCriteria: 新增双输入阀正例：两个 DO 分别连接 `coil_extend` 与 `coil_retract`
新增反例：端口缺失或接错端口会被语义门禁拦截
新增多输入/多输出设备最小回归样例（如 motor）以证明框架可扩展
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: 核心示例迁移到端口级 relation DSL
userStories.description: As a RustPLC user, I want canonical examples to use explicit port relations so that I can copy the new standard directly.
acceptanceCriteria: 更新 `examples/two_cylinder.plc` 为 relation + Device.Port 写法
更新 `examples/assembly_station.plc` 为 relation + Device.Port 写法
更新 `examples/recovery_templates/estop_recovery.plc` 为 relation + Device.Port 写法
示例中不再出现 `driven_by`/`reports_to`/`detects` 设备属性
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: 测试夹具与门禁回归用例全面迁移
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want parser/semantic/verification tests migrated to relation DSL so that CI reflects the new contract.
acceptanceCriteria: 更新 parser/semantic/verification 现有 fixture 到 relation + Device.Port
新增旧写法失败测试，确保破坏性变更被锁定
新增端口歧义不允许的测试（缺 from_port/to_port 或错误端口）
